source_artifacts.role: canonical event-window artifact already present in the active XRP research PR
source_artifacts.treatment: Use as the sole canonical BLS/XRP event observation. It includes the same official release, same Kraken rendered-response digest, and additional derivatives/ETF context.

canonical_additional_coverage: explicit event cutoff and retrieval upper bound
duplicate_comparison.finding: The new supplemental artifact repeated the same BLS event and exact Kraken ticker response already recorded by the canonical artifact. It adds no independent observation.

application_contract.archive_view_rule: Treat the two artifacts as one event. Count only the canonical artifact in research summaries, event features and source/observation totals. Retain the duplicate solely as an audit trail for the redundant capture.
application_contract.reason: Duplicate source content is not independent corroboration and must not increase sample counts, source independence counts or feature-store observations.
